scope: Read-only initial watchdog review; no runtime, signals, control tests or Go-tree hashes. Underlying restore source review remains separately scoped.

finding.trigger: Post-Popen or timeout checkpoint journal write/fsync raises while restoration child still runs.
finding.actual: Exception handler only attempts another save then rethrows; no finally/exception child settlement.
finding.expected: Bounded own-child/group settlement independent of checkpoint persistence success; forced/incomplete/error remains failed and retained.
finding.whyRelevant: The helper performs storage mutations; a receipt-I/O failure must not abandon those mutations without the prepared wall watchdog.

additionalScope: Leader wait is not an independent descendant census. A timed/forced path must not claim complete tree cleanup from only leader settlement; preserve explicit uncertainty if unavailable.
